title: Make drain approve in-limit proposals and work approved jobs
summary: Drain currently lists audience implementation-rung proposals as "needs a person" and ignores the Proposed job that approve-work creates. Retry: drain approves open proposals whose rung the raising role may change itself, works jobs recorded as approved by a work decision, and its module docs say so. The audience is the operator running `athena drain`.

defaults_applied.how: New drain tests cover in-limit approval, above-limit waiting, and approved-job pickup; clippy and fmt must be clean.
Fix both causes: the queue view ignores in-limit proposals and approved jobs.
One focused change in drain and the helpers it needs.
Update module docs, changelog and design doc so an outside reader sees the new behavior.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: In-limit means the proposal's rung is at or below the raising role's limit; unknown roles and above-limit proposals stay waiting.
Rejecting and approving above-limit proposals stay with people.
A job already closed is not picked up again; an approved job read but still in state proposed is run once.
The producer must run cargo fmt --check, clippy --all-targets and test and report evidence per criterion, including the new drain.rs text, before reporting done.

acceptance_criteria.text: A drain test gives an open proposal on the implementation rung from a role whose limit covers it. The proposal is approved, its job is read, run and landed, and it is absent from the report's waiting list. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.

A drain test shows a proposal above its raising role's limit, or from an unknown role, is neither approved nor worked and still appears as waiting with the "needs a person" text. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.

A drain test shows a job that a work decision records as approved and that is still in state proposed is picked up and run once by drain, and a closed job is not picked up again. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.

The module doc in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs no longer contains "has no way to accept, approve or land". It states that in-limit proposals are approved and approved jobs are worked, and that rejecting and approving above-limit proposals stay with people.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` pass for the workspace.

out_of_scope: Approving proposals above a role's limit
Changing the ladder or role limits themselves
Changes to Athena's harness or pre-report gate
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass rate than reference: this task failed once on a missed doc and check criterion and touches several crates.
